title: Standing at the Hollow Throne, 'weigh the doors of the seat' was the only way to learn what each of the four real endings actually required — and by then it was already too late in the run to qualify for any of them. Nothing earlier (journal entry, NPC dialogue) flagged that these specific things would be needed.
